title: Is Memorization Context-Sensitive? Prefix-Based Extraction Beyond Isolated Prefixes
abstract: arXiv:2610.12085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can expose memorized training sequences under prefix-based extraction: given a prefix from a training example, the model may assign high probability to the original continuation. In deployed systems, however, prefixes are rarely evaluated in isolation. They often appear together with instructions, retrieved documents, or other task-specific context, as in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This motivates examining whether contextual conditioning mitigates memorization or merely changes the set of memorized samples that become extractable. We investigate this issue through paired item-level measurements of probabilistic suffix extraction. For each prefix-suffix pair, we score the target suffix under an empty prompt and under retrieved contexts of varying relevance, across three open-weight instruction-tuned models. translated_title: 记忆是否对上下文敏感？超越孤立前缀的基于前缀的提取
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在基于前缀的提取方式下可能暴露其记忆的训练序列：给定来自某个训练样本的前缀，模型可能会给原始续写内容赋予高概率。然而，在已部署的系统中，前缀很少被单独评估。它们常常与指令、检索到的文档或其他任务特定的上下文一同出现，例如在检索增强生成（RAG）中。这促使我们考察：上下文条件化究竟是缓解了记忆化问题，还是仅仅改变了哪些被记忆的样本变得可提取。我们通过对概率性后缀提取进行成对的项目级测量来研究这一问题。对于每个前缀-后缀对，我们在空提示以及不同相关性的检索上下文下对目标后缀进行评分，实验涵盖三个开源权重的指令微调模型。我们发现，上下文并不会简单地抹除记忆。相反，可提取的记忆会……
tldr: 该研究发现检索文档等上下文条件并不会简单消除大语言模型的记忆泄露风险，而是会改变哪些被记忆样本变得可被提取。
en_tdlr: Contextual conditioning such as retrieved documents in RAG does not simply erase LLM memorization; instead, it changes the set of memorized samples that become extractable.
